name: Lucy's Bakery
notes: All 3 photos are printed menu boards (torta/sandwich/tamale menu), each covering a different section, no duplicates. Photo 2's price column has a diagonal glare across it that fully obscures the leading digit of 8 prices (Chorizo, Chorizo & Potatoes, Queso Fresco, Breakfast Croissant, Torta de Tamal, Cuernito Regular, Ham or Turkey Sandwich, Tuna Sandwich); those items are kept with legible names/descriptions but no price rather than guessing the digit. Add-on lines (avocado/cheese/meat/veggies upcharges, choice-of-meat callouts) were omitted as modifiers.
